updates.title: Purview Endpoint DLP Now Protects FTP and SFTP Transfers
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP has expanded to monitor and block sensitive data transfers over FTP and SFTP protocols from managed endpoints. Admins can now configure FTP/SFTP activities in Endpoint DLP policies to prevent unauthorized data exfiltration across these file transfer methods.

updates.title: Purview DLP Expands to Microsoft Cowork
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention now extends to Microsoft Cowork, allowing admins to enforce unified DLP policies across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork environments. This integration enables protection of sensitive AI interactions by blocking labeled knowledge sources, filtering sensitive information types in prompts, and preventing sensitive data from being sent to external search services.

updates.title: Purview DLP Inline Protection Expands for Unmanaged Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP policies will gain browser inline protection support for a significantly broader range of unmanaged generative AI applications in Edge for Business. Admins can leverage existing Purview policy experiences to detect and protect sensitive data shared through these browser activities, extending data security controls to more cloud and AI destinations.

updates.title: Purview DLP Restricts External Email Processing in Copilot
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP is expanding to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing emails originating from senders external to your organization. This real-time control mitigates data exfiltration risks by blocking external email content from being consumed by AI models without explicit organizational approval.

updates.title: Purview Auto-Labeling Supports Legacy Office File Formats
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview server-side auto-labeling is expanding to support legacy Microsoft Office file formats (.doc, .xls, .ppt) in SharePoint and OneDrive. Organizations can now automatically evaluate and apply sensitivity labels to these older file formats, improving compliance across mixed legacy and modern document environments.

updates.title: Purview Data Lifecycle Management Enables Version Trimming in Retention
updates.summary: Admins with appropriate Purview RBAC permissions can now enable controlled file-version trimming for OneDrive and SharePoint content governed by retention policies. This capability allows organizations to reclaim storage consumed by retained file versions while maintaining compliance with legal holds and records management policies.

updates.title: Purview Graph API Now Supports Archive Mailbox Access
updates.summary: Microsoft Graph API now provides unified access to archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary) for compliance workflows, offering admins a single seamless archive view across potentially distributed mailbox storage. This enhancement prepares organizations for the October 2026 deprecation of EWS Graph APIs.

updates.title: Multiple Authorization Vulnerabilities Patched in Microsoft Edge (Chromium)
updates.summary: Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) has ingested patches for multiple authorization-related vulnerabilities identified in Chromium components including Chromoting, BrowserTag, Downloads, WebProtect, USB, Select, SiteIsolation, Extensions, Core, and BFCache. Organizations should ensure Edge is updated to the latest version to receive these security fixes.
